notes.title: The Black Vault 1.2.0
notes.content: [h2]The Second Content Update is Here[/h2][p]This update adds tons of new content and Quality of Life changes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Audio Files[/b][/p][p]Audio files are now present on the webservers, you can now listen to the creepy sounds hidden on the Deep Web. There's also a music folder with a bunch of tracks by IcyDioxide and Kurtense.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TH3SW4N[/b][/p][p]TH3SW4N is a new Nightmare exclusive virus that requires you to enter a code from time to time in order to avoid a complete system shutdown of the computer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Websites[/b][/p][p]Added 5 new sites (2 were made by the community member "vincent"). We also added a website some of you might know called "Beer Opening Tips" with a new design, fresh new tips and the ability for you to submit tips of your own.[/p][p][/p][p]There's way more in this update, read the changelog below for more information. Happy Playing![/p][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog[/h3][p]New: [/p][p]- The Shadow can now jumpscare you on the cameras[/p][p]- Added 4 new websites: The Silent Signal, Elara's Grasp, Shroom Space and Drug Central[/p][p]- Added a sound player, you can now find different audio files scattered around the webservers.[/p][p]- Added a new setting: Max FPS - This splits the resolution and max fps settings into two[/p][p]- Added TH3SW4N[/p][p]- Added Beer Opening Tips with fresh new tips and the ability to submit your own ones[/p][p]- You can now set the scale of the Computer UI (range 50%-100%)[/p][p]- ScriptsCentral now offers a website search service - Just enter the name of the website and it will return the URL[/p][p]Changes:[/p][p]- The satellite code on nightmare mode will always be the max length[/p][p]- When you click on RIFT's URL bar it will now select the URL[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where The Dark Index, DEAD_DROP, Darkshell and ScriptsCentral would not reset their scroll after reloading the page[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where the checkmark in some settings would fly out of the list[/p]

tags.feature: - The Shadow can now jumpscare you on the cameras
- Added 4 new websites: The Silent Signal, Elara's Grasp, Shroom Space and Drug Central
- Added a sound player, you can now find different audio files scattered around the webservers.
- Added a new setting: Max FPS - This splits the resolution and max fps settings into two
- Added Beer Opening Tips with fresh new tips and the ability to submit your own ones
- You can now set the scale of the Computer UI (range 50%-100%)
- ScriptsCentral now offers a website search service - Just enter the name of the website and it will return the URL

tags.balance_change: - The satellite code on nightmare mode will always be the max length

tags.feature: - When you click on RIFT's URL bar it will now select the URL

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where The Dark Index, DEAD_DROP, Darkshell and ScriptsCentral would not reset their scroll after reloading the page
- Fixed a bug where the checkmark in some settings would fly out of the list

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.6 - NIGHTMARE BUFF
notes.content:
This update buffs Nightmare mode heavily and fixes some small bugs

Nightmare Buffs:
- Black Fuse is active from the start
- Inflation hit the markets 
- exploREMOTE is a little faulty now
- The Kidnapper is now more determined than ever
- Anxiety has been buffed heavily 

Fixes:
- You can no longer die due to time during the nightmare ending
